# EduNews
> Education media, market intelligence, and institutional directory for Egypt, the Gulf, and Morocco.

## Editorial Desks
- [Higher Education](/news/higher-ed/): University rankings, research developments, and academic governance.
- [K-12 & International Schools](/news/schools/): National curriculum updates, Thanawya Amma regulations, and tuition fees.
- [Ministry & Policy](/news/policy/): Official decrees, legal frameworks, and regulatory reforms.
- [EdTech & Innovation](/news/edtech/): Classroom technology, AI tools, and startup developments.
- [Admissions & Opportunities](/opportunities/): Funded scholarships, university open days, and student guides.
